function.name: move_to
function.description: Move the robot arm end-effector to an absolute [x, y, z] target in meters. RobotAPI validates the target independently — safety cannot be bypassed. The returned result is authoritative: check success=true before treating the move as complete. On success, result contains requested, actual, and position_error (m). On failure, error.code is IK_FAILED or OUT_OF_BOUNDS. Do NOT call this to manually reproduce pick/place internals.

x.description: X coordinate in meters (lateral, reachable: -0.30 to 0.30).

y.description: Y coordinate in meters (forward reach, reachable: -0.35 to -0.05).

z.description: Z coordinate in meters (height above table, reachable: 0.00 to 0.35).

function.name: pick
function.description: Pick up an object (e.g. red cube or blue sphere) using the built-in deterministic horizontal side-approach grasp routine. Handles open gripper, approach, slide-in, settle, close, and lift internally. Do NOT manually reproduce these steps with move_to and gripper calls. Preconditions: target object must exist in simulation (returns OBJECT_NOT_FOUND if missing), robot must not already be holding an object (returns INVALID_STATE if already holding). success=true means the position heuristic confirmed the object lifted with the arm. success=false with EXECUTION_FAILED means the object did not lift.

target.description: Target object to pick up, e.g. 'cube' (red cube) or 'sphere' (blue sphere).

function.name: place
function.description: Place the currently held object (cube or sphere) at an absolute [x, y, z] target position and release the gripper. Precondition: robot must be holding an object (returns NOT_HOLDING if not). Releases the object at target. Call 'state' afterwards to verify whether the object stayed at the destination or rolled away. Known locations: right pad (0.15, -0.18, 0.015), left pad (-0.15, -0.18, 0.015).

x.description: X coordinate in meters (right pad: 0.15, left pad: -0.15).

function.name: gripper
function.description: Directly set the gripper jaw openness. 0.0 = fully open, 1.0 = fully closed. Use for manual gripper control only — pick and place manage the gripper internally. success=true returns commanded value, actual openness, and is_closed (jaw state). success=false with INVALID_ARGUMENT if value is outside [0.0, 1.0].

function.name: state
function.description: Query the live robot and world state. Returns concise semantic state: robot status (ready/holding), gripper status (open/closed), holding flag, held_object, end-effector position [x,y,z], and exact coordinates and workspace relations of cube and sphere. Authoritative source of physical truth. Use this before planning and after physical actions to verify outcomes.

function.name: camera
function.description: Capture an image from the wrist-mounted camera and save it to disk. Returns the filesystem path to the PNG file. Use when the user asks for a photo or visual inspection. Does not trigger physical movement.

function.name: reset_home
function.description: Return the arm to its default home resting position. Safe to call at any time. success=true returns the home end-effector position. Does not affect the gripper state.

function.name: scenario
function.description: Execute a pre-programmed pick-and-place or inspection scenario by name. A: pick cube and place on right pad (0.15, -0.18, 0.015) then return home. B: pick cube and place on left pad (-0.15, -0.18, 0.015) then return home. C: move arm up, save camera photo, sweep left and right, return home. Returns semantic state on completion.

function.name: collisions
function.description: Query currently detected physical contact pairs between robot parts, table, and cube. Returns in_contact (bool) and a list of contact pairs by geom name. Useful to check whether the arm is touching something unexpected.
